bio: As the Mather House Academic Coordinator, I help students navigate academic and administrative requirements related to Administrative Board petitions, the premed application process, maintaining student files and recommendations letters, and tracking progress toward graduation. I’ve been at Harvard since 2018. Before Harvard, I was on an engagement team that helped school leaders in K-12 develop curriculum and programming that increased students’ academic achievement, and trained teachers to work more effectively with students and families. I’m passionate about education and assisting students in accessing resources that support their academic growth and overall well-being, especially first-generation college students. I have a BS in Biology and an Ed.M. in Human Development and Education (Go HGSE!). Please feel free to contact me if you have questions about academic and administrative requirements while at Mather House and in preparation for graduate school.
